concepts.definition: An algebraic equation expresses equality between two expressions, and a solution is a numerical value for the variable that renders LHS equal to RHS.

concepts.title: Solving Two-Step Linear Equations (Ax + B = C)
concepts.definition: Linear equations in one unknown of the form Ax + B = C are solved by subtracting constant B from both sides and dividing by coefficient A.
concepts.key_idea: Apply additive and multiplicative inverse operations sequentially to isolate the unknown.

concepts.title: Solving Equations with Variables on Both Sides
concepts.definition: Equations structured as Ax + B = Cx + D are simplified by grouping variable terms on one side and numerical constants on the opposite side.
concepts.key_idea: Subtract Cx from both sides and B from both sides to combine like terms.

concepts.title: Fixed Charge and Unit Cost Word Problems
concepts.definition: Problems involving a one-time fixed base charge and a constant fee per unit are modeled by linear relation base + rate * units = total.
concepts.key_idea: Deduct the flat fee from the total budget before dividing by unit rate.

concepts.title: Brahmagupta Method for Ax + B = Cx + D
concepts.definition: Ancient Indian mathematician Brahmagupta formulated a direct solution rule for linear equations Ax + B = Cx + D by dividing net constant difference by net coefficient difference.
concepts.key_idea: The root is computed as difference of constants divided by difference of unknown coefficients.
